static_traits.name: Zhang Di
static_traits.social_status: 因Self-doubt而减少与朋友和同事的联系，Social withdrawal；虽有少数Writer朋友，但羞于分享自我not足
static_traits.medical_history: deny以往相似心理问题与治疗史；No major physical illness
static_traits.language_features: 配合度高，表达清晰连贯，语速平稳；能进行自我Reflection并接受探讨；带有明显自责与羞耻，初始略紧张但逐渐开放

basic_info.main_problem: 我一直觉得have not人想买我的书，这让我相信自己一定是个糟糕的Writer。
basic_info.core_demands: 当这些负面想法开始影响我的写作动力和整体心理健康时，我决定寻求咨询。
growth_experiences: 大约一年前，最新一本书销量not及自己的Anticipation，由此开始出现强烈的Self-doubt与not足感。
其后多次收到出版社的拒信，这些经历进一步加重了Self-denial和低自我价值感。
Book sales have declined in the past year, confidence has been set back, gradually becoming alienated from friends and colleagues, and daily writing motivation and efficiency have markedly decreased.

special_situations.event: 最新一本书的销量have not达到自己的Anticipation
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我的书卖not好，就说明I am not good enough/我是个糟糕的Writer
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 加倍改进写作技巧和营销策略以证明自己价值
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: not人想买我的书，我就是写得not好

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果被出版社拒绝，就说明I have no value，职业可能要完了
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reduced socializing接触，回避进一步投稿或主动求助以避免再次被拒
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们拒绝我，说明我not行，我的写作生涯可能完了

special_situations.event: 在写作或尝试推广作品的过程中反复冒出负面念头
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果without法立刻获得积极反馈，就证明I am not good enough
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 拖延或回避写作与推广任务，降低暴露在评价面前的机会
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 反正也not会有人买，写了也not用

core_conflict.wish: 渴望被认可与接纳，盼望自己的作品被读者和出版社肯定
core_conflict.fear: 害怕Being rejected与被negate，担心失败意味着自我价值低下
defense_goal: 通过自我隔离与Reduced socializing接触来降低被评价和受伤的可能性
以Intellectualization方式归因为“市场/营销因素”以暂时缓解羞耻与Anxiety

object_relations.self_representation: not够好、容易失败的创作者
object_relations.object_representation: 挑剔的评判者/拒绝者（读者、出版社、同行）

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当咨询师邀请其为“销量not佳=我很差”的想法寻找其他解释或证据时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Shifts attention to objective factors to avoid directly facing the shame of being rejected (transference: experiencing the counselor's inquiry as a scrutiny of self-worth)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Steady tone, emphasizes data and multi-factor analysis (market competition, marketing effort), reducing expression of emotional coloring and subjective feelings.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当谈到拒信与销量下滑等失败经历时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Equates external rejection with the inferiority of overall self-worth (internalizing others' evaluation into an attack on the self)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use自我贬低与自责的语句，降低自我评价，语气带羞耻与without力，避免寻求支持。

manifestations: 因Self-doubt与羞耻而与朋友、同事疏离，减少交流
outcomes: Reduced social support与Increased subjective sense of isolation
Anxiety与低落情绪累积，进一步削弱写作动力

manifestations: 主观体验为“写作事业走not下去”
销量下滑与拒信被解释为自我without价值的证据
outcomes: 写作Decreased motivation与日常生产力受损
Impaired sense of self-worth，增强without望感

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: 初始表达紧张且带羞耻，谨慎陈述自我not足，担心被评判
倾向先自责、降低自我价值后再寻求反馈

positive_force: 主动求助且态度积极，愿意尝试行为实验与外部反馈
具备文学Bachelor's degree背景与持续写作经验
拥有少数可联系的Writer朋友，具备潜在社会支持资源
negative_force: 灾难化、过度概括与个人化的思维模式ReinforcementSelf-denial
Social withdrawal与羞耻感导致回避外界评价与支持
销量下滑与拒信经历反复trigger失败图式，进一步削弱自信与动机

target_behavior.behavior: 写作动机显著下降，出现拖延与回避
antecedent: 坐下来写作或准备推广作品时
想起最新一本书销量not佳
收到或回想起出版社的拒信
target_behavior.core_reason: 将销售表现与自我价值直接等同的灾难化与过度概括认知，强烈害怕失败与被negate
target_behavior.function: 逃避潜在的失败与羞耻，短期降低Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: 生产力下降、日常作息被打乱，Career development受阻

antecedent: 需要向朋友或同行分享写作近况时
需要寻求他人反馈或推广作品时
target_behavior.core_reason: 将外部拒绝个人化为“我not行/not够好”，担心暴露缺陷
target_behavior.function: 逃避被评判与再次受挫
target_behavior.consequence: 支持系统削弱，Increased sense of loneliness，自尊进一步下降
